title: Philippine Labor Code Article
description: Schema for articles from the Labor Code of the Philippines (Presidential Decree No. 442)

article_number.description: Article number in the renumbered Labor Code (DOLE, 2015), e.g. 294

former_article_number.description: Article number before the 2015 renumbering (e.g. 279 for Art. 294 [279])

enum: Book IV: Health, Safety and Social Welfare Benefits
Book VII: Transitory and Final Provisions

title_name.description: Title within the book (e.g., 'Title I: Termination of Employment')

chapter.description: Chapter within the title, if applicable

content.description: Full text of the article, enumerated items included (they are also broken out in `subsections`)

original_pd_442.description: False when the article was inserted or added by a later law rather than enacted in the original Presidential Decree 442 (1974)

amendments.description: List of amendments to this article

related_articles.description: Renumbered article numbers cross-referenced in this article's text

implementing_orders.description: DOLE Orders that implement or clarify this article, as normalized order numbers (e.g. 'DO-147-15'); taken from the article's editorial footnotes, and may be extended by cross-linking with the DOLE Order dataset

heading_footnotes.description: Editorial footnotes printed on the Title or Chapter heading above this article; a repeal stated there covers every article under it

heading.description: The heading carrying the footnote, as in title_name or chapter

footnotes.description: Editorial footnotes the source edition attaches to this article (amendment history, superseding laws, implementing rules)

provenance.description: Where the record came from and what produced it

source_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the source PDF; matches the pin in data/sources.toml

parser.description: Parser name and version that produced the record (e.g. 'labor-ingestion 0.1.0')

subsections.description: Subsections or paragraphs within the article

law.description: Law that amended this article, normalized (e.g., 'RA 6715', 'PD 850', 'BP 130', 'EO 111')

date.description: Effectivity date of the amendment, when the amendment note states one

description.description: The amendment note as printed (e.g., 'As amended by Section 34, Republic Act No. 6715, March 21, 1989')

legal_status.description: What the source edition's editorial notes say about the article, reviewed by hand in data/labor_code_status.toml. Reports those notes only: it is not a finding that an article is in force, and later laws are outside the edition. Absent when the source PDF has not been reviewed.

status.description: no_change_noted: no reviewed note says the text changed. partly_superseded: part of the article, or how it operates, no longer applies as printed. superseded: the whole article no longer applies as printed.

effect.description: How the note describes the change

part.description: The part affected (e.g. 'second paragraph'); absent when the note covers the whole article

by.description: Law or decision that made the change (e.g. 'RA 11210')

footnote.description: Number of the footnote stating the change

content.description: Text content of this item only (nested items are in `subsections`)
